title: Before ‘Jana Nayagan’: When an 18-year-old Vijay walked the halls of Loyola
description: Vijay’s maiden venture as a solo hero, Naalaiya Theerpu, helmed by S.A. Chandrasekhar, did not set the box office on fire; even as the audience response remained muted, the actor was noticed, and he won the Best New Face Actor award from Cinema Express
